## Contribution / 贡献内容

Describe what you are sharing or changing and how it relates to Lody.
说明你分享或修改了什么，以及与 Lody 的关联。

## Checklist / 检查清单

- [ ] Followed the scenario/type structure and filled metadata / 已按场景和类型放置并填写元信息
- [ ] Added usage instructions or an external resource introduction / 已提供使用说明或外链介绍
- [ ] Declared content languages and credited original sources / 已标注语言及原作者和来源
- [ ] Updated both homepage links for new entries / 新条目已更新双语首页导航
- [ ] Reviewed configuration fields, file references, and links / 已核对配置字段、文件引用和链接
- [ ] Original contributions use MIT; copied third-party notices are preserved / 原创投稿采用 MIT，第三方资源保留必要授权说明

Maintainer execution and bilingual submission content are not required.
不要求维护者实际运行，也不要求投稿正文双语。
